projectName: RTX AVC | R3.5 W-101 POWER TREE — engineering test HOLD
notes: R3.5 W-101 power distribution snapshot; may duplicate conceptual circuits from W-100 and is NOT an extra set of installed components.
Working model, not a native Wiring Studio import/export or fabrication release.
Cable lengths and many terminations remain unassigned; use DRC summary to track completeness.

pins.description: 6S LiPo pack positive at up to 25.2V full charge to F0 rated DC fuse as close to battery as physically feasible. Battery type, connector and installed wire gauge still unknown.
